scope: Official primary abstract and bibliography pages only. No full-paper, appendix, AtP* or second-order method replication.

sources.title: AtP*: An efficient and scalable method for localizing LLM behaviour to components
sources.supported: Gradient-based attribution patching approximates activation patching and has documented failure modes.
sources.limit: No implementation of AtP*, error bound, exhaustive neuron sweep or novelty claim.

sources.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
sources.supported: Evaluation metric and corruption choices can change localization results.
sources.limit: A new continuous metric does not overturn the prior program-level null or prove a semantic role.

sources.title: When Attribution Patching Lies: Diagnosis and a Second-Order Correction
sources.supported: The abstract analyzes first-order approximation errors and proposes second-order corrections.
sources.limit: No HVP, integrated gradients, coefficient fitting or new gradient computation is proposed here.

decision: Measure exact finite output changes for already fixed groups. Do not claim a new attribution method or explain earlier nulls before evidence.
